steps.en: Add the openai/codex-plugin-cc marketplace in Claude Code and install the plugin
steps.zh: 在 Claude Code 里添加 OpenAI 的插件市场并装上插件

steps.en: Run setup once to confirm Codex is installed and signed in
steps.zh: 跑一次 setup，确认 Codex 已安装且已登录

steps.en: Finds your local Codex CLI and login, offering to npm-install Codex if it is missing
steps.zh: 找到本机 Codex CLI 和登录状态；缺 Codex 时提议用 npm 装

steps.en: Before opening the PR, ask Codex to review your branch
steps.zh: 开 PR 之前，让 Codex 审一遍你的分支

steps.en: Starts the Codex app server and runs Codex's built-in review in a read-only sandbox
steps.zh: 拉起 Codex app server，在只读沙箱里跑 Codex 自带的评审

steps.en: Returns Codex's findings verbatim into the Claude session, without changing your code
steps.zh: 把 Codex 的审查意见原样带回 Claude 会话，不改你的代码

value.en: A model from a different lab reviews the diff inside the same Claude session — no pasting patches into a second tool
value.zh: 另一家厂商的模型在同一个 Claude 会话里审你的改动——不用再把补丁粘进第二个工具

sources: README.md main @ db52e28 (2026-07-08): Install (/plugin marketplace add openai/codex-plugin-cc; /plugin install codex@openai-codex; /reload-plugins; /codex:setup offers npm install of Codex), Usage /codex:review (--base main, read-only, same review as /review in Codex), Codex Integration (wraps the Codex app server, uses the global codex binary)
plugins/codex/commands/review.md: return Codex output verbatim, do not fix issues
plugins/codex/scripts/lib/codex.mjs: review/start request, sandbox read-only; plugins/codex/scripts/lib/app-server.mjs: spawn("codex", ["app-server"])
